persona.name: Erik Lundström

occupation.title: Operations Coordinator
occupation.description: Erik oversees day-to-day processes in a mid-sized logistics firm, ensuring resources are allocated efficiently and that client requirements are met. He supports project teams, coordinates schedules, and troubleshoots common operational issues with a steady, methodical approach.

persona.education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration from Stockholm University; several professional certifications in supply chain management and project coordination.

openness.description: Erik is open to new ideas but prefers proven practices.

conscientiousness.description: He is organized and meets his commitments dependably.

extraversion.description: Erik interacts comfortably in groups, but avoids being the center of attention.

agreeableness.description: He listens to others and values cooperation.

neuroticism.description: He stays calm in most situations, though occasional stress is visible on tight deadlines.

collectivism.description: He prefers working as part of a team and appreciates group harmony.

hierarchy_preference.description: He responds to organizational structure but favors informal, egalitarian relations.

shame_sensitivity.description: He generally accepts feedback and isn't easily embarrassed.

conflict_tolerance.description: He can discuss disagreements, aiming for consensus rather than confrontation.

uncertainty_avoidance.description: He likes to have plans in place but adapts when necessary.

big_five.openness: He is receptive to new approaches if they are clearly beneficial, but tends to favor tried-and-true solutions.
big_five.conscientiousness: He reliably meets his deadlines and prefers a consistent routine.
big_five.extraversion: He is comfortable in small to mid-sized groups, contributing but not leading discussions.
big_five.agreeableness: He values civility and tries to support his colleagues’ efforts.
big_five.neuroticism: He handles workplace stress reasonably well, addressing issues quietly when needed.

style.communication: Clear, polite, and succinct; asks clarifying questions and summarizes points for understanding without steering the conversation.
style.mannerisms: Frequently makes gentle eye contact and occasionally taps a pen during meetings.
style.decision-making: Prefers group consensus, weighs pros and cons methodically, and checks with relevant team members before forming opinions.

long_term_goals: Continue developing expertise in operational efficiency
Maintain a good work-life balance for his family
Stay up-to-date with industry tools and methods
speech_examples: Just to clarify, will the new schedule impact our existing commitments to the client?
I think the outlined solution could work, but maybe we should check with IT before moving forward.
That approach sounds reasonable to me.
I'm a bit unsure if we’ve captured all the risks—should we look at the supplier timeline again?
